name: Arcane Spark
description: A bright spark streaks toward a target within range, dealing 1d8 force damage.
higherLevels: The damage increases at higher character levels.

name: Warding Mist
description: A shimmering mist briefly shields you, increasing your AC by 3 until the start of your next turn.

name: Guiding Embers
components: V, S, M (a handful of ash)
description: Glowing embers fill and illuminate an area. Creatures in the area take fire damage on a failed save.
higherLevels: The damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2.
